/.title: Android SMS gateway and API from your own SIM
/.og: Turn an Android phone into an SMS API.
/.description: Send and receive SMS from code through an Android phone and its SIM: REST API, webhooks, SDK, MCP server. Open source, self-hostable, no per-message fees.

/pricing.title: Pricing: free plan, Pro, Scale, or self-host
/pricing.description: Free for 30 messages a day and one phone. Pro is $12 a month for 10,000 messages and three phones, Scale $39. Self-hosting is free with no limits.

/download.title: Download the Android app (APK)
/download.description: A signed APK for Android 8.0 and newer: pair the phone with your account, send what the API asks, forward incoming texts, update itself. No Google Play.

/docs/api.title: SMS API reference: every endpoint
/docs/api.description: Every endpoint of the simhook REST API, generated from its OpenAPI document: messages, phones, webhooks, API keys, plans, errors, and pagination.

/about.title: About: who makes it, the source, the licence
/about.description: Who makes simhook, where it runs, how to reach us, and what is open: the server under AGPL-3.0, the SDK and MCP server under MIT.

/changelog.title: Changelog: app, SDK, and MCP server releases
/changelog.description: Every release of the simhook Android app, the TypeScript SDK, and the MCP server, with dates and notes, read from GitHub Releases at build time.

/compare.title: Own-SIM SMS gateway vs hosted SMS APIs
/compare.description: What changes when SMS goes through a phone and SIM you own instead of a hosted API: cost, numbers, carrier limits, reliability, and when not to do it.
